speaker: Last Star
text: The first fire remembers where the roads once led.

speaker: Bearer
text: Then let it lead us.

speaker: Last Star
text: Six voices. None of them were the monster.

speaker: Bearer
text: We carry the voices. Leave the monster here.

speaker: Last Star
text: They laughed here, even while the sky was failing.

speaker: Bearer
text: Good. Let the night hear them.

speaker: Sun-Eater
text: Every reflection ends inside me.

speaker: Last Star
text: Don’t look.

speaker: Bearer
text: I saw the one that doesn’t.

speaker: Last Star
text: The sea buried the final road.

speaker: Bearer
text: Buried isn’t gone.

speaker: Last Star
text: The Engine guarded a door no map remembers.

speaker: Bearer
text: The thunder remembered.

speaker: Sun-Eater
text: I have watched you fail in every hour.

speaker: Bearer
text: You only watched.

speaker: Last Star
text: The Foundry still burns beneath us.

speaker: Last Star
text: They made you to carry me.

speaker: Bearer
text: They don’t choose what I become.

speaker: Cartographer echo
text: The map… was bait.

speaker: Sun-Eater
text: Complete the circuit. Bring me the star.

speaker: Last Star
text: It used our wake.

speaker: Bearer
text: Yes—and taught us where to close the line.
